_source: Korinek et al. (2026), Anthropic 'Economic Scenarios for Transformative AI', Table 3: US 2030 endpoints. gdp_gap = 'GDP, pct. above the no-AI path' as published (the row the dashboard shows); growth = GDP growth in 2030 (%); lshare = labour share (cents per dollar). idx2030 is carried over from the earlier uk-ai-study pipeline; each value equals the published 'GDP, index with 2024 = 100' (112.7, 114.5, 122.1, 149.3) divided by 1.02^2 (issue #21). The ratio of those rounded indices gives Extreme 32.5 where the published row is 32.4, so gaps are read from gdp_gap, not from idx2030.
